description: Publish the open draft: it is assigned the next edition number, gets its permalink, goes out on the RSS and JSON feeds, and TURNS THE PUBLIC PAGE ON if it was still off. Strangers can read it from this call onward. Read the draft with get_changelog and check it against what actually shipped before calling this. For publishing on a schedule, set a review window with set_changelog_cadence instead: it gives a person a stated number of days to intervene, which this does not. Reversible only for the most recent edition, via unpublish_changelog_edition. Audited. Requires the MANAGER role or above.

editionId.description: Changelog edition id (uuid): get_changelog returns these

name: publish_changelog_edition
title: Publish changelog edition
